Mia's birthday is in February. Last Sunday, Jack and Mia went to the reading room. Jack thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. The temperature dropped to zero.
Jack and Mia had great fun there. Life is full of small surprises. There are always many people at the science lab. Best of all, maths is fun when you understand it.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the reading room by bike. Jack borrowed a book about science from the museum. Jack hopes to visit Sydney one day. What's more, the provost revised the exam rules.
Mia is interested in dancing. The reading room is one of the best places in the city. Jack wants to be a engineer in the future.
